titulo: GTA 6 Fans Are Excited For Another Date In November, And It’s Not Release Day
texto: Take-Two has announced the details for its next earnings briefing, and as you might expect, GTA 6 fans are circling the date on their calendars. The next Take-Two quarterly earnings report will be released on Monday, November 9, with management holding a call at 1:30 PM PT / 4:30 PM ET that day to discuss the results and answer questions. Anyone can listen to the call online. The report is being released 10 days before GTA 6 launches on November 19, so it's expected that analysts and investors will ask questions about the upcoming launch. Management, including CEO Strauss Zelnick, will likely have some kind of update or commentary to share. However, fans should not hold out hope for any big details about the game itself, as those kinds of details historically come by way of developer Rockstar Games. titulo: God Of War’s Laufey Collector’s Edition Leaves One Important Thing Out: The Game
texto: The God of War Laufey Collector's Edition has been revealed, but unlike the standard and digital deluxe editions that went up for preorder last month , this is purely a box of merch. Spotted on the UK PlayStation Direct store , the main attraction of this collector's edition is a light-up statue of the game's protagonist, Faye, locked in combat while Phranque the Cube watches on. The set also includes a deck of 51 oracle cards and a small art book, all housed in collector's edition-packaging. As noted in the image, God of War Laufey is sold separately, and this edition costs £130 if you're purchasing it from across the pond. In the US, this will likely cost around the same in US Dollars given the price parity between PlayStation regions, and you'll need to shell out another $70 for a physical edition to complete it.
